newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares extend modest gains.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares extend modest gains.

text.p: Latvian shares saw modest gains on Wednesday in light trade but dealers were not terribly optimistic about the market's short-term prospects.
Overall market volume fell to 71,000 lats from 122,000 lats and the Rietumu index rose 0.77 percent to 190.6.
Dealers said the recent gains were promising but cited a lack of big buyers and big companies and low liquidity as the biggest obstacles to market momentum.
"We really need bigger companies and serious investors," said one dealer.
"That could be said for all three Baltic bourses," he added.
The session's biggest loser was the Valmiera fibreglass plant, a leading secondary list stock, which shed 14.90 percent, falling to 1.37 lats from 1.61 lats in trade of 4,000 lats.
"Valmiera's recent gains were speculative, and attracted small investors... but serious investors wouldn't buy at such a high price, so it came down," said one dealer.
Of the five official list shares, three gained, one held steady and one eased a bit.
The Riga Transport Fleet rallied after falling sharply on Tuesday, rising 10.4 percent to 1.27 lats in trade of 4,600 lats.
Unibanka extended its gains, climbing ten santimes to 3.60 lats in trade of 23,900 lats. It was the session's most active share.
